llm.evidence: Online liquid chromatography-tandem mass spectrometry (LC-MS/MS) was performed using a hybrid Q-Exactive-HF mass spectrometer (Thermo Scientific).
45 μg of peptides from each sample were labeled with ten different amine-reactive isobaric tandem mass tags (TMTs) (TMT10plex 126–131Da, Thermo Scientific).
The SP3 beads-protein mixture was digested first by Lys-C (Pierce, Thermo Scientific, Waltham, Massachusetts) for 16 h prior to trypsin digestion (16 h).
were followed by data-dependent MS/MS (35 000 resolution) on the top five ions
using higher energy collision dissociation at 30–40% normalized collision energy.
The microdissected tissue was dissolved in SDS-lysis buffer (4% SDS, 25 mm Hepes pH 7.6, 1 mm DTT).
The supernatant was collected and alkylated with 4 mm chloroacetamide.
